raw.details:
Hustle Carnival is the flagship hybrid buildathon hosted by Club Ellusion, the official technical club of G.L. Bajaj Group of Institutions, Mathura. Designed around the vision “Hustle Beyond,” this event brings together student coders, designers, and innovators from engineering and management disciplines, including CSE, IT, ECE, AI/ML, and MBA.

Hustle Carnival is an Open Innovation Buildathon, where participants are encouraged to think beyond boundaries, identify real-world problems, and develop creative, technology-driven solutions of their choice. There are no predefined problem statements—teams have the freedom to choose their own domains, explore ideas, and build projects that demonstrate innovation, creativity, and practical impact.

The event promotes hands-on product development, team collaboration, and real-world problem-solving. Participants will gain exposure to industry-standard tools through a dedicated Git & AI Tools Workshop, expert mentorship sessions, and opportunities to pitch their prototypes before an expert panel of judges and industry representatives.

OFFICIAL WHATSAPP GROUP :
https://chat.whatsapp.com/KRNR8A2WrXi7CFsAWQ1TeH?s=cl&p=a&mlu=4&ilr=4

Contact  +91 8630322914  in case whatsapp link doesn't  work .

IT'S  Mandatory to join official whatsapp group 

Event Structure & Rounds

Round 1: Online Video & PPT Submission

  • Mode: Online
  • Final Submission Deadline: 22 October 2026, 2:00 PM
  • Results Announcement: 23 October 2026, 10:00 AM

Participating teams must prepare and submit a PowerPoint presentation (PPT) and a project video showcasing their proposed solution, project concept, target problem, implementation approach, and expected impact.

Since Hustle Carnival is an Open Innovation Event, teams can choose their own problem statements and project domains. Participants are encouraged to develop original ideas that address real-world challenges and demonstrate creativity, feasibility, and innovation.

Submission Requirements:

  • Submit the final PPT and project video on or before 22 October 2026, 2:00 PM.
  • Showcase your project on LinkedIn using the official Hustle Carnival event banner.
  • Include the official hashtags: #Ellusion #HustleCarnival #GLBajajMathura.
  • Follow the official WhatsApp group for submission instructions and important updates.

Selected video submissions may be featured on Club Ellusion's official YouTube channel.

Shortlisting: Approximately the top 35% of participating teams will qualify for the on-campus finale.

Result Declaration: Phase 1 results will be announced on 23 October 2026 at 10:00 AM. Shortlisted teams must check the official communication channels for results and further instructions.

Phase 2 Participation Important Notice

  • Applicable To: Only teams shortlisted after Phase 1.
  • Purpose: Confirmation of participation in the offline finale.

Shortlisted teams must complete the payment before the deadline to confirm their participation in Phase 2. Payment instructions will be shared through the official WhatsApp group. 

Round 2: On-Campus Finale – 6-Hour Buildathon

  • Date: 24 October 2026
  • Time: 9:20 AM to 4:30 PM
  • Mode: Offline
  • Venue: Block A & B, G.L. Bajaj Group of Institutions, Mathura
  • Eligibility: Teams shortlisted from Phase 1

The on-campus finale is an intensive, six-hour buildathon where shortlisted teams will develop functional prototypes based on their own innovative ideas.

As an open innovation event, participants can work on projects across various domains, including AI/ML, web development, app development, healthcare, education, sustainability, fintech, productivity, and other areas of interest.

Teams will collaborate, code, test, and refine their solutions while receiving mentorship and technical guidance throughout the event.

Finale Highlights:

  • Six hours of hands-on coding and prototype development.
  • Freedom to build innovative solutions in a domain of your choice.
  • Dedicated mentor check-ins and expert guidance.
  • An interactive Git & AI Tools Workshop.
  • Live project demonstrations and pitch presentations before an expert judging panel.
  • Networking opportunities with industry professionals, mentors, and potential recruiters.

Eligibility & Participation Rules:

  • Participation in Phase 1 is mandatory for consideration in Phase 2.
  • Only shortlisted teams are eligible for the offline finale.
  • Projects must represent original work developed during the designated buildathon hours.
  • Teams should bring their own ideas and be prepared to develop and demonstrate their solutions during the buildathon.
  • All teams must follow the event schedule, submission guidelines, and instructions provided by the organizing committee.

The event is open to undergraduate students from B.Tech departments, including CSE, IT, ECE, and AI/ML, as well as MBA students.

Rewards & Perks

Participant Goodies

Finalists will receive customized event merchandise, including T-shirts, stickers, badges, notebooks, and pens.

Certificates

Physical certificates will be awarded to winners, while e-certificates will be provided to participants of Phases 1 and 2.

Industry Opportunities

Participants will get opportunities for networking, mentorship, and potential internship or hiring opportunities through industry partners.

Skill Development

Gain practical exposure to Git workflows, collaboration tools, and modern AI developer tools through interactive workshops and hands-on sessions.

Project Showcase

Present your ideas, demonstrate your prototypes, and receive feedback from experts and judges.

Important Dates & Deadlines

Activity Date & Time
Final PPT & Video Submission 22 October 2026, 2:00 PM
Phase 1 Results Declaration 23 October 2026, 10:00 AM
Phase 2 Confirmation Deadline  23 October 2026, 11:00 PM
On-Campus Finale 24 October 2026, 9:20 AM–4:30 PM

Event Details

  • Event Name: Hustle Carnival 2026
  • Tagline: Hustle Beyond
  • Organized By: Club Ellusion – Technical Club
  • Institution: G.L. Bajaj Group of Institutions, Mathura
  • Event Type: Hybrid Open Innovation Buildathon & Technical Workshop
  • Phase 1: Online Video & PPT Submission
  • Phase 2: On-Campus 6-Hour Buildathon
  • Finale Date: 24 October 2026
  • Venue: Block A & B, G.L. Bajaj Group of Institutions, Mathura

Join the Hustle Carnival Community

Join the official WhatsApp group to receive event updates, submission instructions, result announcements, payment instructions, and other important information.
